extraFacts.fact: Safety factor is the ratio of minimum burst pressure to maximum working pressure; the Indus listings give 3:1 for these bulk-material hoses, so the 10 bar A361 has a minimum burst of 30 bar.
extraFacts.source: Indus Hydraulics product listings for A361 and PREMFLEX (specs); ratio arithmetic

faqs.q: What is the A361 bulk material suction and delivery hose 10 bar used for?
faqs.a: The A361 is a heavy-duty rubber suction and delivery hose for mining, construction, civil engineering, foundries and bulk transportation. It has an abrasion-resistant synthetic rubber cover, an anti-static natural rubber tube and a steel helix, so it moves sand, cement and similar solids. See [bulk material and sandblast hose](/blog/bulk-material-and-sandblast-hose).

faqs.q: Which bore sizes does the Indus A361 bulk material hose come in?
faqs.a: The Indus A361 is listed in two bores, 3" (76 mm) and 4" (102 mm), with outside diameters of 92 mm and 120 mm. Part numbers are IH-IH-A361-076 and IH-IH-A361-102. State the bore and assembly length when you enquire so the correct coupling is quoted.

faqs.q: What is the working pressure of the A361 10 bar bulk material hose?
faqs.a: The A361 is rated 10 bar maximum working pressure on both listed bores, with a minimum burst of 30 bar, a 3:1 safety factor. That is a low-pressure rating for suction and gravity-fed delivery lines; do not use the hose for high-pressure pumping.

faqs.q: What temperature range can A361 abrasive hose be used in?
faqs.a: The A361 operates from -40°C to +70°C. Its natural rubber tube suits dry bulk solids, sand and slurry at those temperatures; for hotter material or steam, choose a hose built for that duty. Our [industrial hose buyer's guide](/blog/industrial-hose-guide) compares the options.

faqs.q: What is the A361 bulk material hose made of?
faqs.a: The A361 has a black anti-static natural rubber tube, high-tensile textile plies with a steel helix and anti-static wires, and a black abrasion-, weather- and ozone-resistant synthetic rubber cover. The wires bleed off static charge from dry material flowing through the bore.

faqs.q: What is the minimum bend radius of the 3" and 4" A361 hose?
faqs.a: The A361 minimum bend radius is 380 mm on the 3" (76 mm) bore and 550 mm on the 4" (102 mm) bore. Keep bends gentler than that and clear of the coupling, because the steel helix is stiff and a tight bend flattens the tube.

faqs.q: How heavy is the A361 10 bar hose per metre?
faqs.a: The A361 weighs 3.76 kg per metre on the 3" (76 mm) bore and 4.55 kg per metre on the 4" (102 mm) bore, empty. Add the weight of the conveyed material when you plan supports, slings or a crane lift on a long run.

faqs.q: What printing and safety factor does the A361 hose carry?
faqs.a: The A361 is printed with the Indus logo and "A361 BULK MATERIAL S & D HOSE 10 BAR" along its length, and it is rated at a 3:1 safety factor. The layline lets you check pressure and type in the field; [reading an industrial hose layline](/blog/reading-an-industrial-hose-layline) explains each element.

faqs.q: What couplings and accessories are used with the A361 bulk material hose?
faqs.a: The A361 is paired with cam and groove, Boss steam couplings, hose clamps and permanently attached fittings, plus Spiral Hose Guard or Fire Jacket sleeves where the hose needs protection. Match the coupling to the 76 mm or 102 mm bore; [cam and groove couplings](/c/cam-and-groove-couplings) are a common choice.

faqs.q: A361 rubber bulk hose or PREMFLEX PVC hose: which should I buy?
faqs.a: Choose A361 for abrasive solids at up to 10 bar and from -40°C to +70°C, and the lighter [PREMFLEX PVC suction and delivery hose](/p/mdse-chemical-abrasion-pvc-suction-delivery-hose) for chemical solutions and slurries at 3 to 5 bar. A361 has a rubber tube and steel helix; PREMFLEX is an all-PVC construction.

faqs.q: What documents can Indus supply with A361 hose for export from Dubai?
faqs.a: We export A361 hose from Dubai, UAE, and prepare the commercial invoice and packing list with each shipment. Certificates of origin and other destination papers depend on the country; [GCC import documents for hose](/blog/gcc-import-documents-for-hose) lists what Qatar, Oman, Kuwait and Bahrain ask for.

faqs.q: Is the A361 bulk material suction and delivery hose in stock in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. We keep the A361 bulk material hose in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the bore, the length and any end-fitting requirements through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.

faqs.q: What is PREMFLEX MDSE chemical and abrasion PVC suction and delivery hose used for?
faqs.a: PREMFLEX is a flexible all-PVC suction and delivery hose for conveying chemical solutions, abrasive slurries and solids. It is built as a PVC tube with a PVC spiral helix and has no separate cover or lining, which keeps it light on the 38 mm to 152 mm bores.

faqs.q: Which bore sizes does Indus PREMFLEX PVC hose come in?
faqs.a: PREMFLEX is listed in seven bores from 1-1/2" (38 mm) to 6" (152 mm): 38, 51, 63, 76, 102, 127 and 152 mm. Part numbers run IH-IH-PREMFLEX-038 to IH-IH-PREMFLEX-152, with outside diameters of 49 mm to 171 mm.

faqs.q: What is the working pressure of PREMFLEX hose at each bore?
faqs.a: PREMFLEX is rated 5 bar on the 38 mm and 51 mm bores, 4 bar on 63, 76 and 102 mm, and 3 bar on 127 and 152 mm. Minimum burst falls from 16 bar to 10 bar over the same range, a 3:1 safety factor, and the pressure drop with bore size is why larger hose carries less.

faqs.q: Can PREMFLEX PVC hose be used on suction?
faqs.a: Yes. Every PREMFLEX bore in the size table is rated for a vacuum of 0.9, and the PVC spiral helix is there to hold the wall open under suction. Use the 3 to 5 bar figure for the delivery side and keep the helix undamaged on the suction side.

faqs.q: What temperature range does PREMFLEX PVC hose cover?
faqs.a: PREMFLEX operates from -10°C to +55°C. PVC stiffens in the cold and softens in the heat, so keep hot product and steam away from it; for higher temperatures see [industrial hoses](/blog/industrial-hose-guide) built for hot service.

faqs.q: What is the minimum bend radius of PREMFLEX hose by size?
faqs.a: PREMFLEX minimum bend radius is 152 mm on the 38 mm bore, rising to 608 mm on the 152 mm bore. The radius is four times the bore across the range, so bends in a 4" (102 mm) line must stay above 408 mm.

faqs.q: Is PREMFLEX PVC hose suitable for chemicals, and how do I check compatibility?
faqs.a: PREMFLEX is sold for chemical solutions, but resistance depends on the chemical, its concentration and temperature, so name the medium on the enquiry before ordering. The tube and helix are both PVC; strong solvents and hot media are the usual limits.

faqs.q: How heavy is PREMFLEX hose per metre?
faqs.a: PREMFLEX weighs 0.70 kg per metre on the 38 mm bore and 5.00 kg per metre on the 152 mm bore; 102 mm is 2.7 kg per metre. Full lines hold much more, so size supports for the contents as well.

faqs.q: What couplings and clamps go on PREMFLEX hose?
faqs.a: PREMFLEX takes hose shank couplings held with clamps, matched to the outside diameter (49 mm on 38 mm bore up to 171 mm on 152 mm bore). [Cam and groove couplings](/c/cam-and-groove-couplings) with a shank end suit quick changeovers; ask us for the shank size you need.

faqs.q: PREMFLEX PVC hose or A361 rubber bulk hose: which is better for slurry?
faqs.a: PREMFLEX is lighter and sized to 152 mm, so it suits chemical solutions and slurry at 3 to 5 bar, while [A361 rubber bulk hose](/p/bulk-material-suction-delivey-hose-10-bar) takes 10 bar and heavy abrasive solids but only in 76 mm and 102 mm. Pick on the pressure, the bore and how abrasive the load is.

faqs.q: What marking does PREMFLEX hose carry and what is its safety factor?
faqs.a: PREMFLEX is printed "INDUS PREMFLEX" along its length and has a 3:1 safety factor on the working pressures listed. For what the printing and ratings mean on a hose, see [industrial hose safety factors](/blog/industrial-hose-safety-factors).

faqs.q: Is PREMFLEX PVC suction and delivery hose available ex-stock in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. We hold PREMFLEX in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Tell us the bore, length and whether you need end fittings fitted through [our contact page](/contact).
